description:
Activate Dr. Beverly Crusher by using Deathbringer Thoctar's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Dr. Beverly Crusher triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
